1.explanation: The core of the problem lives in UpdateLabelHandler.js. In its helper `ensureInternalLabelDi` it sets `di.label = null` when the text is cleared, which leaves an explicit (null) property on the DI. In the same handler’s `postExecute`, when an embedded label is deleted (`isEmptyText`), it calls `modeling.removeShape(label, { unsetLabel: false })`, so the DI label property is never removed. To fix the bug, this file needs to stop writing `label = null` (or explicitly delete the property) and/or call `removeShape` with `unsetLabel: true` so that the `di.label` property is fully removed rather than left as null.
1.bug_scenario: When you clear a Task’s name in the modeler, the underlying BPMN DI element still has a `label` property (set to null) instead of having that property removed. In the screenshot you see a Task with its name removed but the DI still carries `label:null`, which triggers lint errors (red “x” icons) even though the business object name is gone.
